title: Sensor: recordings and descriptive analysis from one participant
description: Six CSV files from one participant, Python code for descriptive analysis, and historical reviews of eleven devices and two facial analysis tools. Raw sensor readings and questionnaire responses cover Session 1. Supplied eye summaries cover three sessions. The author reports consent for research and educational sharing. Device identity, calibration and cross-stream synchronization remain unverified. CC BY 4.0 covers original observations and authored documentation where rights are held. Code uses MIT. Questionnaire wording, answer options, product images and trademarks retain third-party rights. Permission to redistribute instrument content openly is unestablished. See NOTICE.md and DATA_ETHICS.md. This metadata does not establish a deposited record or DOI.
